theme: The last open Sunday before Croatia.
greeting: The day is almost entirely yours, Dan - one short review with Mike, then open water. It's also the last clear window to lock the pre-departure bookings before Tuesday's flight.

needsAttention.title: Croatia bags, in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Basic Economy. Pull the booking up on the operating carrier's own site with the record locator, confirm the allowance shows there, and buy bags online now if they're missing - counter fees on European carriers run well above the pre-purchase price, and two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on.

needsAttention.title: The Sept 19 Cavtat night
needsAttention.detail: The charter disembarks at noon Sept 19 up at Komolac. Book a refundable Cavtat room for that night, the marina transfer, and the ~5:15 AM airport run for the Sunday flight. Charter connectivity is poor, so this has to be booked from land before the Sept 8 departure.

needsAttention.title: The St Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sept 20 but the girls aren't picked up until Sept 22 - two nights (Sept 20-21) near St Pete still have no room. Worth a glance too that the pending Sept 27-Oct 5 Airbnb actually converted to confirmed rather than expiring.

needsAttention.title: The car-rental hedge
needsAttention.detail: Sept 7 is the stated decision point. Unless Mike's car is confirmed en route to Florida with a written delivery window by tomorrow, book the refundable Full-Size SUV out of TPA for Sept 20-Oct 5 rather than finding out jet-lagged at a Sunday walk-up counter.

needsAttention.title: Halloween - St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: The girls are in residence for it, and the Oct 18-Nov 1 St Pete Airbnb and car both already cover the weekend. That booking fires while you're at sea, so the call is best made before Tuesday - one decision drives three downstream bookings.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: 15-min board reset - owners and dates on everything

flagged.title: Airbnb host on the Sept 27-Oct 5 St Pete stay
flagged.detail: The host messaged about a cancellation and Mike replied that you're all good. Worth confirming it settled as the confirmed booking rather than a re-open.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and sales - Yale Club of Maine, Foreign Affairs, NYPL, Field Company, a Kayak Dubrovnik deal, a couple of Kickstarters.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Autumn brings squash and hearty roots to the table, so this is a dish for the turning season.

tasks.title: Contact the Nautilus instructor - boarding time and return transfer
Finish the Nautilus Masterclass videos (~68% done)
Build and pack the travel larder bin
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: A 15-minute Sunday review with Mike at 9 - the weekly board reset - and nothing fixed on the calendar after it.
The calendar is clear straight through, the last unclaimed daylight before you leave dry land.
Two days out from the Croatia flight, with the girls home until the handoff around Tuesday.
